notes.recognition: The bent stance and braced torso read as depleted at board scale; the beat becomes subtler at 72 px.
notes.agency: The raised route light makes continued guidance, not victimhood, the focal action.
notes.specificity: Map-cloak, compass, lantern, and expedition tailoring preserve the Routekeeper identity.
notes.restraint: One clear figure and warm signal remain legible without effects or scenery.
notes.continuity: Charcoal cloth, brown field gear, cyan compass, and gold light match the approved visual language.
notes.reusability: Clean alpha and complete silhouette support board, card, and status-overlay use.
notes.accessibility: Pose and lantern silhouette carry the state without relying on color.
